notes: Reviewer found the PoC effect demonstrated default admin/admin access, not the CVE-2025-25247 services-console XSS root cause.

title: Unauthenticated fileserver MOVE can write uploaded content to arbitrary filesystem paths
notes: Confirmed on pinned ActiveMQ 5.11.0 source/config with local-only receipt; not evidence for latest master.

title: HTTP transport deserializes attacker-controlled XStream XML without a type allowlist
notes: Real historical unsafe-XStream condition, but already covered by Apache CVE-2015-5254 / AMQ-6013 remediation.

title: DIME/SOAP attachment upload and parser resource exhaustion
notes: PoC showed attacker-controlled DIME attachment materialization for services that access attachments and SOAP root memory pressure; default Version service did not materialize attachments, so vendor reportability is weak/disputed.
